scope: Enrich an existing immutable Test reference. Test is the canonical loader's specialization of an explicitly referenced file under tests/ or unit_tests/, not an execution result, parsed function inventory or independent authored test schema.

authorities.role: Strict six-field entity envelope with an open properties mapping.
Relationship locator and source provenance remain outside node metadata.
Canonical producer identity, surface, title, description, path and missing flag.
Original file-reference anchor belongs to the edge.
Index-first reference resolution, path identity, anchor separation, original existence observation and one files-surface node per canonical path.
Classifies files-surface paths beginning tests/ or unit_tests/ as Test and creates the pinned SourceReference and reference flags.
Defines the three exact adapter-injected properties that must be excluded when enriching a previously enriched entity.

record_identity.input: One existing Entity with kind exactly Test. Do not run repository traversal, parse test files or reclassify other input kinds by their paths.
record_identity.native_id: Preserve entity.canonical_id exactly. Producer-generated Test IDs are normalized repository-relative paths, but an already valid existing identity is not replaced with source.path.
record_identity.locator: Preserve entity.source.locator exactly, including its normally empty value.
record_identity.title: Preserve entity.title exactly, including an empty or custom title.
record_identity.description: Preserve entity.summary exactly, including an empty string.
record_identity.metadata: A deep copy of the complete Entity envelope: canonical_id, kind, title, summary, source and properties. Preserve source and properties as nested objects so their field names cannot collide with envelope fields.
record_identity.derived: Empty object. Do not manufacture file extension, test framework, function names, runtime state, outcome, ownership, execution timestamp or coverage status.
record_identity.repeat_enrichment: Exclude only _native_projection, _native_identity and _native_source_path from the nested properties copy. Preserve other _native_ prefixed properties; blanket prefix removal would discard real future data. Never mutate the input Entity.

fields.meaning: Original display title; empty remains empty.
Original summary; no source-body parsing or fallback.
Complete pinned SourceReference, copied without recomputation.
Exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters in the existing SourceReference schema.
Non-empty repository-relative POSIX path. Existing contract rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, backslashes and colons; reject invalid inputs instead of repairing them.
Existing source locator; distinct from each referencing relationship's test-function anchor.
Preserve the pinned value exactly. Empty is a valid legacy/partial contract value and does not authorize reading current disk.
Open mapping preserving all original simple and nested metadata except the exact three adapter exclusions.
Reference origin; preserve its original value and presence.
Original reference-existence observation at projection time. False, true and absent remain distinct; do not recalculate from supplied root.
Producer authority flag for files-surface references, not a test-pass or file-presence flag.
Existing reference flag, not inferred from the path or current registry.

test_reference_semantics: A Test reference may originate from any surface-declared file_path_fields entry; covered_by is not the only possible producing relationship.
tests/a.py::Class::test_one and tests/a.py::Class::test_two refer to one file node with two relationship locators. Do not create function nodes or collapse away their separate edge anchors.
The producer strips the first # or :: suffix and preserves the rest as the edge anchor. canonical_loader copies this anchor into Relation.locator.

The original classification checks files-surface paths beginning tests/ or unit_tests/; it does not inspect Python naming conventions, extension, executable content or collected tests. A referenced support file or directory can therefore already be typed Test. Preserve the existing classification rather than add new heuristics.
The source reader has no authority to infer component membership from a referencing AC, directory name, imports, body content or test function name.
An existing source-file node and a future authored artifact at the same path have distinct identities. Enrich the supplied Test only and preserve all snapshot edges.
pinned_missing_and_hash_semantics: Original file references record missing as not path.exists() under the source snapshot. canonical_loader hashes actual bytes only for is_file(), otherwise hashes empty bytes.
A missing path and an existing empty file share the SHA-256 of empty bytes. Retain missing to distinguish them; do not derive it from the hash.
A directory can have missing=false and an empty-byte hash. Do not reinterpret it as absent or attempt recursive content hashing.
A historical missing reference remains missing even if root now contains the file. A historical present reference retains its old hash and false missing flag even if current root lacks it.
from_entity requires no filesystem observation. root exists for integration compatibility and must not be used to refresh, validate existence or hash the referenced source.
Hash verification or pinned-source content disclosure belongs to the existing source loader/resolver, outside this metadata adapter.
metadata_fidelity: Preserve all materialized Entity and SourceReference fields, including defaulted empty summary, locator, content_hash and properties. These are already contracted references, not authored frontmatter whose absent keys can be reconstructed.
Within properties, preserve absent versus explicit null, empty string, empty list, empty map, booleans, numbers, list order and nested object association.
Preserve future property names, including properties.source, properties.title and unknown _native_ prefixed names, without overwriting envelope provenance or presentation fields.
Use Python-mode values and a deep copy. Mutating the returned metadata must not change the input entity, and changing input nested values later must not change the record.

The shared native-property encoder exposes nested leaves with escaped JSON Pointer keys and shape metadata; retain the canonical payload and distinguish null/empty/absent rather than stringifying nested objects as the sole representation.

neo4j_exposure.reference_tree: Expose the entire reviewed metadata tree, especially /source/source_sha, /source/content_hash, /source/path and /properties/missing.
neo4j_exposure.ordinary_flags: The shared display_properties adapter already exposes existing simple Entity.properties fields as ordinary properties, so missing, surface, canonical and registry_identity remain directly filterable. The nested reference tree preserves the complete contract independently.
neo4j_exposure.runtime_fields: Do not add pass/fail, success, duration, executed_at, test_result or coverage facts. Existing arbitrary properties with such names must still be preserved if supplied; the reader never manufactures them.
neo4j_exposure.relationship_fields: Keep the existing anchors and relationship source provenance on their existing relationships. This metadata reader creates no additional nodes or relationships.

algorithm: Require kind Test and validate the existing Entity/SourceReference shape, including safe source path, without accessing the filesystem.
Deep-copy the complete Entity metadata envelope using Python-mode values, excluding only the exact three adapter-injected properties.

Return NativeRecord(kind='Test', native_id=entity.canonical_id, source_path=entity.source.path, locator=entity.source.locator, title=entity.title, description=entity.summary, metadata=reference_copy, derived={}).
Do not add extract(root), repository scanning, body parsing, test discovery, current-disk hashing or component inference.
Leave input entity identity, source, original properties and the snapshot's relationships unchanged.
acceptance_checks: A present Test preserves all six Entity fields, all five SourceReference fields and all four current reference flags.
A missing Test preserves its exact canonical ID, source hash and missing=true even when a file now exists under root.
A present Test preserves its pinned hash and missing=false when root lacks the file; no filesystem read, exists check or hash calculation occurs.
Empty hash, locator, title, summary and properties stay empty, and a canonical ID different from source.path is preserved.
Absent flags remain absent; explicit false, null, nested objects, ordered arrays and empty structures survive metadata encode/decode.
Metadata deep-copy isolates nested source and properties from mutations in both directions.
Only the exact three adapter keys are stripped during repeat enrichment; unrelated _native_ prefixed and envelope-colliding property names survive.
SourceFile, AC, Component and other input kinds fail explicitly; invalid source paths fail without filesystem access.
The adapter never parses test functions or infers component membership and leaves derived empty.
Multiple function anchors to one file remain separate existing relationships and do not become extra metadata fields or Test identities.

count_basis: No repository test enumeration performed. Native Test records are exactly the existing Test entities provided by the caller's immutable snapshot.
